candidates.text: The last support stays in place. Method is still carrying the result.
What remains after the spectacle is the method that carried it.
A deadline earns meaning when it makes the next action visible.
Newness begins where an object becomes usable.
A release begins only when someone can truly enter it.
Culture lives where an object finds its public.
A frame matters only when it changes the action.
An entrance is already an editorial decision.
空间不是背景，它决定谁能留下。
真正的结束，是让选择终于可见。
发布不是终点，而是对象第一次被使用的条件。
方法没有退场，它仍在承担结果。
